column1: # Tested on nx2android v0.3.0 with the expanded virtual address layout in game.tsv.
# menu, puzzle rendering and controls work; tester completed a puzzle without issues.
# Original 4.38 GiB alias region exhausted (AllocateAddressRegion 0x1803), then SIGSEGV.
# +8 GiB alias headroom resolves startup; physical app_pool remains unchanged.
# Pixel 9 Pro / system Mali-G715: boots, but persistent rendering corruption.
# Disabling zero-copy removes visible corruption but was reported far too slow.
# That diagnostic option is deliberately NOT enabled here. Pixel 9a untested.
# No custom driver is bundled or selected by this profile; no full-playthrough claim.
